item.title: LiteLLM Proxy Pre-Authentication SQL Injection via Error-Handling Callback (CVE-2026-42208)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-42208 (GHSA-r75f-5x8p-qvmc). Status: Weaponized (public working PoC + Docker lab, actively exploited in the wild within 36 hours of disclosure). Affects: LiteLLM Proxy — open-source LLM/AI gateway (22,000+ GitHub stars) fronting OpenAI, Anthropic, and other model provider APIs. Tags: litellm, ai-gateway, llm-proxy, sql-injection, cwe-89, unauthenticated, remote, blind-sqli, kev-adjacent, credential-theft.
